tooltip.ludocraft.ludka_stake: One item. One chance. Choose your risk.
screen.ludocraft.risk_0: 50% · x2 · Iron → diamond, diamond → netherite. Gems → 1–2 diamonds. Mod gear: repair + random enchantment; resources x2.
screen.ludocraft.risk_1: 25% · x4 · Iron → netherite. Diamond gear → netherite + a random enchantment. Gems → 4 diamonds. Mod gear: repair + random enchantment; resources x4.
screen.ludocraft.risk_2: 10% · x10 · Strongly enchanted netherite gear. Gems → netherite ingot or enchanted golden apple. Mod gear keeps its item type and gets compatible maximum enchantments.
screen.ludocraft.risk_3: 5% · x20 · MAX RISK! Elytra, nether star, mace or a named Ludka Jackpot with maximum enchantments.
screen.ludocraft.input_hint: Click or Shift-click to insert. Tools, armor, weapons, gems and ingots, including modded items. Unsupported items can be taken back.
tooltip.ludocraft.ludka_compat: Modded items supported via types and tags.
